body: Independent orchestrator review of PR #392 at the head the chain fetches after the update-branch onto the current main (the worker's head 85547ca5 on ce032e14; task dotfiles-T130-claude-sandbox-integration-a01, the operator's 21:0x JST directive, dispatched to a004 at 12:36Z, amendments 1 to 6 at 43daecc1; 150 changed lines outside tests and the template (cap 200) and 276 under tests (cap 1000); task copy 43daecc1 = the dispatched text; CI 16 of 16 on 85547ca5; Bot: review 5557862602 on a06f646f with P1 4302738193 fixed:4498a262 (herdr-agents as the Linux top-level excluded command), review 5557934127 on 4498a262 with P2 4302795772 (README 464-480) advisory under dotfiles-T130-claude-sandbox-integration-followup-a01, no thread on the final head; no P0/P1 open. After the merge the operator runs make update, restarts the seats, does the live check and seats the second Codex seat on spark-9e8d. The head the chain audits is the update-branch merge onto the current main.
